1. A sweat sensing system, comprising: - a mesh (12) for location over a sweat surface on which sweat is formed or collected, the mesh having a set of mesh openings; - a vibration system (18) for vibrating the mesh to provide oscillation adapted
to nebulize sweat droplets; - a condensing unit (22) for condensing the nebulized sweat droplets on a sensing surface; and - a sweat sensor (26) for biomarker sensing of the sweat at the sensing surface.
2. A system as claimed in claim 1, wherein the vibration system is for vibrating the mesh to provide oscillation in a frequency range 20 kHz to 2 MHz.
3. A system as claimed in claim 1 or 2, wherein the condensing unit comprises a set of one or more chimney arrangements (36).
4. A system as claimed in claim 3, wherein the chimney arrangements each comprise a U-shaped channel (40).
5. A system as claimed in claim 3 or 4, wherein the chimney arrangements each comprise at least one hydrophobic channel (62) and at least one hydrophilic channel (60), with the sensing surface in a hydrophilic channel.
6. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 5, further comprising a discharge chamber (27) for collecting sweat from the sensing surface after sensing.
7. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 6, further comprising a charging system (29) for charging the nebulized sweat droplets with a first charge, for charging the sensing surface with an opposite, second charge, and for charging surface regions away from the sensing surface with the first charge.
8. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 7, further comprising a dilution reservoir (28) and a fluid delivery system for delivering fluid from the dilution reservoir to the sweat surface.
9. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 8, wherein the mesh (12) is for location over and in contact with the skin.
10. A system as claimed in claim 9, wherein each mesh opening or a sub-set of mesh openings define a pooling chamber having a volume of 1nL or less.
11. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 8, further comprising:
a support layer (52) for mounting over the skin and which defines a collection reservoir which comprises the sweat surface (50), above the skin surface; and
a fluid delivery system (54) for delivering sweat from the skin surface to the collection reservoir.
12. A system as claimed in claim 11, wherein the fluid delivery system (54) comprises a microchannel arrangement.
13. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the sweat sensor comprises a capture species immobilized on a surface for binding a target analyte and a detector for detecting the presence of the bound target analyte.
14. A system as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 13, wherein the system is formed as a patch for application to the skin. 5 10 15 20 25
